metadata.purpose: Forward the source and then each supplied Observable in strict subscription order.

conditions: Exactly one input subscription is live at a time; source index 0 always starts first.
The next supplied source is subscribed only after the previous source completes.
Each incoming value is emitted unchanged; completion requires all inputs to complete.

scope.parameters: One piped source and 2 supplied Observable inputs; 0–32 others. Deprecated operator export. No projector or scheduler overload.
scope.callbacks: No user callbacks; no result selector projection. Observable values preserve reference identity.
scope.time: Inputs supply all notification ordering; no clock, scheduler or delay is created by this profile.
scope.reentrancy: All input subscriptions established atomically before external notifications. Synchronous producer emissions during setup are excluded.
exclusions: Promise/iterable ObservableInput conversion, synchronous or reentrant notifications during subscription acquisition.
Deprecated result selector for combineLatest and deprecated scheduler overload for concat.
Callbacks throwing during observer delivery, synchronous finalizer reentrancy, cancellation during next handling.
Finite scenarios are evidence, not universal equivalence. Input count beyond 32 is not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Subscribe only the piped source; remaining sources wait for completion.

ownership.sharing: No multicasting, sharing or replay. Each result subscription owns independent latest slots or serial position.
ownership.reset: Fresh first-value flags and subscriptions for every execution; closed states accept no notifications.

resources.owner: each result subscription, generation is source index

dispatch.actionSemantics: Forward each input next unchanged; release an input at completion before acquiring the next.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between resolved notifications; cancel active subscriptions without a terminal notification.
Termination releases only live resources and never creates a late shared subscription.

inputs.description: one live source delivers a value

controls.description: latest slots or serial active input

rules.explanation: Construction is lazy. Source index zero is the piped source.
Concatenation preserves the identity and order of every value.
Only completion permits advancing the serial source.
There is no next subscription after the last input.
Failure aborts the join, without subscribing to more sources.
